requirements.summary: Fixed exact-commit pre-round hooks execute once in order before each planner and fail closed.
Round-zero production readiness executes the fixed aggregate, gate, human-authority, and invalidation policy before planning.

factory-state/v2 is the legacy pre-migration format; canonical factory-state/v1 is the exact section 11 field set, and the readiness/pre-round extension data lives in strict campaign-bound sidecars (factory-pre-round-hook-state/v1, factory-readiness-state/v1), never in canonical state.
Runner aggregate v4 adds campaign/readiness namespace and bounded artifact metadata while preserving RUNNER-01 fail-closed trust semantics.
